packet_features.binding: kāma — worldly / physical desire and longing: grasping for wealth, opulence, name, fame, social position; the tamasic pull toward the crude
packet_features.liberating: physical longing sublimated / redirected toward the higher — desire turned from kāma toward mokṣa (the longing for liberation); worldly grasping released

packet_features.binding: ensconcement gone rigid — over-holding, clinging to one's holding; stuck fixity that resists the movement toward subtlety
packet_features.liberating: dharma — ensconcement in one's original (true) stance; the sustaining principle ('that which sustains'), the unbroken movement toward subtlety and merger into Parama Puruṣa (mānava dharma)

packet_features.binding: avajñā — neglect / disregard of what actually has value; indifference misapplied so that genuine worth goes unattended
packet_features.liberating: regard that recognizes and attends to worth — giving due attention to what has value (and reserving indifference/upekṣā only for the truly unacceptable)

packet_features.binding: kruratā — cruelty: physical harm inflicted on the weak; crude, cruel thought and behaviour
packet_features.liberating: compassion (karuṇā) that protects the vulnerable — the counter-measure to cruelty; the will to reduce another's misery and help arouse their latent intellect

packet_features.binding: mūrcchā — hypnotic entrancement, the loss of common sense / discernment under the spell of a ripu (deluded obsession that suspends judgment)
packet_features.liberating: breaking the entrancing spell into clear sense — withdrawing the mind (pratyāhāra) along the path of righteousness, no longer spellbound (aided by kīrtana / devotional song)

packet_features.binding: aviśvāsa — self-doubt that cannot commit: lack of confidence and wavering ('shall I be able to do it?'), distrust of self and others
packet_features.liberating: self-efficacy — the confidence to commit and to rely: steady trust in oneself, others and the path

packet_features.binding: peevishness / reactive irritability — perverse, contrary reactivity discharged at others (taking offence at kindness, calm under harshness)
packet_features.liberating: forbearance that absorbs provocation — an even, unreactive temper that does not discharge irritation

packet_features.binding: cintā as anxious rumination — the mind churning over unresolved contingencies and personal consequences (e.g. worrying through the late-train inconveniences), gripping the what-ifs
packet_features.liberating: cintā as composed, impersonal reflection — holding an unsettled situation open without forcing premature closure; objective contemplation in which one is 'not a direct player' (e.g. weighing how a failing industry might be revived), reflection without anxious grip

packet_features.binding: restless striving that cannot stop — effort compulsively driven on, unable to cease (and, clung to mundane ends, ceaseless outward striving)
packet_features.liberating: will-force applied to arouse one's dormant higher potential — purposeful effort that exerts and then rests into poised, alert repose without inertia; the effort behind spiritual elevation

packet_features.binding: the inflated 'I did / I control this' — the 'I'-feeling swollen into sole doership (as in Aurangzeb: 'had I not been there the world would have been destroyed')
packet_features.liberating: agency exercised WITHOUT inflating the 'I' — acting and functioning while not claiming sole doership

packet_features.binding: praśraya / praṇāśa — giving latitude to the point of dissolution; unrestrained indulgence that runs to annihilating collapse
packet_features.liberating: disciplined containment that holds form — latitude restrained and sublimated so the dissolving tendency is contained rather than annihilating

packet_features.binding: mamatā bounded by the relative factors (time, space, individuality) — partial, possessive 'mine-ness' that clings to its own (own child, own country, own moment) while excluding or even harming what lies outside it
packet_features.liberating: mamatā made to TRANSCEND time, space and individuality — love expanded past its relative boundaries into universal affection that holds the loved on an open hand (achievable only by human beings, through persistent, intense effort)
